author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer throws 49 pitches in rehab start Friday
desc: Max Scherzer threw 49 pitches in a rehab start on Friday.
impact: Scherzer allowed two runs on three hits over three innings with three strikeouts and two walks. It is unclear how many more starts he'll need on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mastrobuoni expected to be called up Friday
desc: Miles Mastrobuoni is in the Mariners clubhouse on Friday.
impact: Mastrobuoni is expected to get called up with Julio Rodriguez getting placed on the concussion IL.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez expected to be placed on concussion IL
desc: The Mariners are expected to place Julio Rodriguez on the 7-day concussion injured list.
impact: Rodriguez left Thursday's game early with the injury. The move will likely be made official before first pitch on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keegan Akin (elbow) 'looking at all options'
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Keegan Akin is "looking at all his options."
impact: Akin was placed on the injured list earlier this week due to elbow discomfort. There should be an update on his status in the coming days when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley (elbow) 'looking at all options'
desc: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said Ryan Helsley is "looking at all his options."
impact: Helsley was placed on the injured list on Friday. There should be an update on his status within the next few days.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sal Stewart goes deep in win over Brewers
desc: Sal Stewart went 1-for-4 in a win over the Brewers with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Stewart continues a torrid stretch at the plate, collecting hits in each of his last eight contests. The rookie remains one of the more explosive bats in the Reds lineup for manager Terry Francona, posting an .813 OPS with 17 home runs, 60 RBI, 46 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Chase Burns solid on mound in win over Brewers
desc: Chase Burns allowed two earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out four over six innings in Thursday's win over the Brewers.
impact: Burns continues an impressive stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 13 of his last 14 trips to the mound. The right-hander continues to reward manager Terry Francona with one of the more impactful starting options in the Reds rotation, carrying a 2.40 ERA and 1.08 WHIP with a 10-1 record and 10.7 K/9 ratio through 17 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hao-Yu Lee goes yard in loss to Rangers
desc: Hao-Yu Lee went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Rangers with a two-run home run.
impact: Lee continues a productive stretch at the plate of late, recording hits in nine of his last 12 contests. The 23-year-old remains one of many streaky options in the Tigers lineup to this point, batting .255 with four home runs, 15 RBI, 11 runs scored, and one stolen base across 50 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colt Keith homers in loss to Rangers
desc: Colt Keith went 1-for-2 in a loss to the Rangers with a solo home run.
impact: Keith has heated up at the plate of late, picking up hits in five of his last six contests. The 24-year-old has offered manager AJ Hinch one of many inconsistent bats in the Tigers lineup, batting .251 with six homers, 19 RBI, 32 runs scored, and four steals through 79 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Geoff Hartlieb designated for assignment
desc: The Athletics designated Geoff Hartlieb for assignment.
impact: Hartlieb loses his spot on the Athletics 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mark Leiter Jr. (hip) activated from IL
desc: The Athletics activated Mark Leiter Jr. from the injured list.
impact: Leiter makes his return to the Athletics bullpen. Geoff Hartlieb was designated for assignment as the corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Framber Valdez tagged early in loss to Rangers
desc: Framber Valdez allowed five earned runs on nine hits and two walks while striking out one over five innings in Thursday's loss to the Rangers.
impact: Valdez has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last six contests. The left-hander continues to frustrate fantasy managers as one of the more inconsistent arms in the Tigers rotation, carrying a 4.29 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 4-6 record and 2.2 K/BB ratio across 18 starts this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Rodon dealing with inflammation in UCL
desc: Carlos Rodón told reporters his UCL is intact, but he has heavy inflammation.
impact: Rodon was placed on the injured list on Friday. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chris Bassitt (back) returns to Orioles, without timetable to return
desc: Chris Bassitt is back with the Orioles and is feeling better, but he remains without a clear timetable to return.
impact: Bassitt underwent surgery to have a bone spur removed from his back. It was a procedure never done before on a baseball player. There should be an update on his status within the next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaramil Hiraldo (shoulder) transfers rehab assignment to Triple-A
desc: Yaramil Hiraldo had his rehab assignment transferred to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Hiraldo will likely only need a couple more appearances on his rehab assignment before returning to the Orioles bullpen.
